text:
elaine: Quick status check — Orchestra customer cutover scheduled tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Need final gating confirmation for networking, certs, and rollback owners. Owners I have: networking=arpit, infra=maria, SRE=kevin. Any blockers?

arpit: Networking update — firewall rules mostly good. One outstanding egress requirement: artifact pull to our CDN and fallback proxy. Waiting on customer NAT IP to put in ACLs. I can document rules once I have the IP.

maria: Infra note — for air-gapped installs we need the CA bundle + wrapped HSM token before handoff. I can stage certs to the image if ops gives me the key handle.

kevin: SRE side — will own oncall 09:00-13:00 UTC during cutover. Need canary rollback steps pinned in the runbook and alert thresholds set. I'll create the alerts this afternoon.

arpit: Quick snippet for firewall team I will send once NAT IP received:
```
# egress ACLs to allow artifact fetch + fallback proxy
allow tcp 54.213.12.7/32 443  # primary CDN
allow tcp 3.21.45.9/32 80    # fallback proxy
```

devops-bot: CI canary status: build-9824 -> green :white_check_mark:  all smoke tests passed. See https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/9824

maria: @arpit do you have the KMS/HSM URI from the customer? without that I can't wrap the key. Also i'll stage the certs under /opt/redwood/certs once provided.

arpit: Not yet — acct team said they'd deliver before EOD today but no token yet. Pinged @account-exec. If they miss EOD this is a gating blocker.

elaine: Two action items then: (1) #networking publish NAT egress IP to this thread (2) #infra stage CA bundle + post sha256. Once both are done I will mark the cutover as "go".

maria: Will stage and post hash after I get the key. Example path I'll use: /opt/redwood/certs/orchestra/ca.pem

kevin: Rolling playbook reminder:
- canary deploy to 1 node
- monitor latency & error rate 10m window
- if errors > 2% rollback to previous image
I'll add exact alert queries to the runbook.

arpit: FYI for firewall folks — customer uses ephemeral NAT, so please allow ranges for a short window if they can't provide IP. I'll coordinate with them.

maria: Posted staging note: CA bundle staged (pending key). sha256: ab12cd34ef56ab78cd90ef12ab34cd56ef78ab90cd12ef34ab56cd78ef90ab12

devops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/orchestra-cutover — includes rollback steps and contact matrix.

elaine: Great — sounds close. If acct team doesn't provide HSM URI by 18:00 UTC we escalate to sales ops. Otherwise we keep the 09:00 UTC cutover. :thumbsup:

arpit: I'll update here when NAT IP shows up.

kevin: I'll post alert dashboards and a one-click rollback snippet in the runbook before EOD.

maria: I'll follow up with ops to confirm they can import the CA into the image.

elaine: Thanks team — will re-open if any blockers appear.
